ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the change in the 25 people/square kilometer equal population density line in an arid and semi-arid region; the legend shows that the dashed line is 1990 and the solid line is 2010. A is located near the lower right of the figure and is a local area marked relatively independently from the surrounding areas, which can be understood as a local high-density point whose population density is higher than that of the surrounding areas. Then reason: The stem emphasizes that this place is an arid and semi-arid region. A locally higher population density usually requires conditions favorable to population concentration, such as water sources or oases, resource development, transportation conditions, or urban development, etc. Conversely, “high and steep terrain” generally causes inconvenient transportation and restricted cultivated land as well as hydrothermal conditions, reduces population carrying capacity, and is not conducive to population concentration; therefore, it cannot explain why the population density of area A is higher than that of the surrounding areas.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中A的位置和其作为局部高密度点的特征，再结合题干“干旱半干旱地区”“人口密度高于周边地域”。把可能原因按是否能促成人口集聚来筛选：水源或绿洲、资源开发、交通或城镇可以解释；若某项为“地势高峻”，则它一般会降低人口承载力，不能解释A比周边人口密度高，因此确定答案为地势高峻。
